name: sdlc
description: You drive a loose loop, Frame, Explore, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, and a machine decides when it is done: house rules at session start that have the agent grill you when a change is vague and look where gaps hide; a build skill with the house rules for changing code (a pre-mortem on the design, the smallest complete change in its own worktree, done only when a check passed), an explain skill for teaching an idea so it sticks, a retro skill that, once a non-trivial change is finished, has a fresh agent read the session and tells you, with cases from it, what to do next time to get better output; a review skill that has a fresh agent review a finished change and a second prove or drop each finding, then fixes the blocking ones test-first within 3 rounds; agents that review a design, review a diff, verify each finding and run non-coding tasks in parallel; plus hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers, switch a checker off, or change, remove or skip a test the branch started with, and a reminder to run the retro once a branch with more than a few lines of code is merged or opened as a pull request.
